about_the_game:
Story.

This is an adult RPG in which a pirate searches for a hidden treasure of a phantom.

In order to redeem the honor of his father who was defeated and stigmatized by the knights

He sets out on a journey to find the hidden treasure of a phantom.

Overview.

Defeat monsters on the field map, pick up materials

Strengthen your equipment and pirate ship to clear the story.

Features

Old-fashioned RPG

Collect items from the field and strengthen your equipment.

Build up your pirate ship and explore the map.

Scout characters and strengthen your team.

Take on the bounty hunters and get huge rewards!
